finding.summary: The synchronous IPageLoader bridge blocks on LoadAsync.
finding.explanation: GetAwaiter().GetResult() synchronously waits for a potentially incomplete page-loading task. If an implementation performs real asynchronous compilation or I/O, callers occupy a thread until completion; impact depends on the concrete loader and cache state.
